summary: גִּרְגָּשִׁי names one of the peoples counted among Canaan’s descendants. The definite singular designates the people collectively.

senses.definition: A gentilic designating the Girgashite people.

evidence.note: The definite singular names the Girgashites alongside the Jebusites and Amorites in Canaan’s genealogy.
The Girgashites appear in a list explicitly counted as seven nations.
